purpose: Consolidate Nutrition Label into the source custom-food editor and retain canonical vitamin activity ownership.
behavior: Foods → Nutrition Label opens New Food with Nutrition Details expanded. Known vitamin forms remain collapsed until requested.
Server-projected form names and IDs drive controls. Individual and mixed shares use the canonical parser and factors; clients do not perform conversions.

Only authored nutrient edits change data. Known → Unknown removes prior conversion-owned activity while retaining IU; explicit manual activity, including identical values and zero, retains its ownership. A new known-form edit becomes the latest conversion owner.
The common reviewed save retains immutable receipt retry, stale-revision draft recovery and transient cancellation. Favorites keep their existing module after obsolete label exports are removed.
canonicalTransforms: Resolve the existing decimal owner through the installed big.js package; keep canonical vitamin factors and label validation.
Track explicit manual vitamin activity ownership in labelActivityOverrides, including same-value and zero writes. New explicit known-form conversion becomes the latest owner.

When an IU amount or form is edited, clear only its prior conversion-owned activity using recorded derivation and serving basis. Unknown forms retain IU without stale converted activity; preserve independent authored values.
Normalize UTF-8 publication text to LF.
limits: The form disclosure is a cloud adapter over the saved source editor and canonical label capabilities; there is no captured native known-form disclosure to reproduce.
